+"""Single-episode RoboPaint trajectory for copying the exemplar 心.
+
+The service is stateful; run this file only against the live episode whose
+trajectory it documents.  Coordinates are world metres, wxyz quaternions.
+"""
+import json
+import math
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+ORI = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)  # brush points straight down
+DT = 0.05
+MOVE_SPEED = 0.10
+DRAW_SPEED = 0.035
+SURFACE_Z = 0.020
+MM_PER_PX = 0.00022186
+PAPER_FAR_X = 0.0135925
+PAPER_LEFT_Y = 0.1135925
+
+
+def pose(xyz):
+    return np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), ORI]
+
+
+def run_path(r, start, end, speed, hold=0, note=''):
+    """Send a straight, 20 Hz sampled ee path and return its final pose."""
+    a = np.asarray(start, dtype=float)
+    b = np.asarray(end, dtype=float)
+    distance = float(np.linalg.norm(b[:3] - a[:3]))
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(distance / (speed * DT))))
+    rows = [a + (b - a) * (i / n) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
+    rows.extend([b.copy()] * int(hold))
+    res = r.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(rows), dt=DT, video='mp4',
+                   cameras=['scene_cam', 'side_cam', 'practice_cam'],
+                   video_fps=10, note=note)
+    if res.meta.get('plan'):
+        failures = [p for p in res.meta['plan'] if p.get('ik_ok') is False]
+        if failures:
+            raise RuntimeError(f'IK failures in {note}: {failures[:3]}')
+    return b
+
+
+def paper_pose(u, v, z):
+    """Main-sheet pixel centre to world pose; image top is the far edge."""
+    return pose([PAPER_FAR_X - (v + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX,
+                 PAPER_LEFT_Y - (u + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX, z])
+
+
+def stage_calibrate():
+    r = Robot()
+    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs().meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+    p = now[7:14]
+    print('initial tip', p.tolist(), 'status', r.status(), flush=True)
+
+    # Load ink at the centre of the visible 20 mm ink well on the left plate.
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.100, 0.148, 0.105]), MOVE_SPEED,
+                 note='move over the ink well')
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.100, 0.148, 0.012]), 0.06, hold=10,
+                 note='dip below the ink surface')
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.100, 0.148, 0.105]), MOVE_SPEED,
+                 note='lift the loaded brush')
+
+    # Practice tests: compare two pressures on the unscored sheet.
+    # Practice lies immediately on the robot-right side, centred at y=-0.164.
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.105, -0.164, 0.105]), MOVE_SPEED,
+                 note='move over the practice sheet')
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.135, -0.175, 0.030]), MOVE_SPEED,
+                 note='lower to practice test 1')
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.135, -0.175, 0.015]), 0.04,
+                 note='press for practice test 1')
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.135, -0.153, 0.015]), DRAW_SPEED,
+                 note='draw practice test 1 at 5 mm press')
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.135, -0.153, 0.030]), 0.04,
+                 note='lift after practice test 1')
+
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.075, -0.175, 0.030]), MOVE_SPEED,
+                 note='position for practice test 2')
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.075, -0.175, 0.009]), 0.04,
+                 note='press for practice test 2')
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.075, -0.153, 0.009]), DRAW_SPEED,
+                 note='draw practice test 2 at 11 mm press')
+    p = run_path(r, p, pose([-0.075, -0.153, 0.105]), MOVE_SPEED,
+                 note='lift clear of the practice sheet')
+
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=['practice_cam', 'scene_cam', 'side_cam'], depth=True)
+    for name, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f'calibration_{name}.png')
+    print('calibration complete', r.status(), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    stage = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'calibrate'
+    if stage == 'calibrate':
+        stage_calibrate()
+    else:
+        raise SystemExit(f'unknown stage: {stage}')
*** End Patch";

+        # replacing it with a contour or a fill.
+        for t in np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 24, endpoint=False):
+            t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
